description: RERUN clause (I-O-CONTROL) - the '85 checkpoint hint (RERUN [ON file/implementor-name] EVERY {{[END OF] REEL/UNIT | n RECORDS} OF f | n CLOCK-UNITS | condition-name}); at 85 the integer-1 RECORDS ON implementor-name-1 form writes its rerun information (the one form §1985:VII.2.12.4 GR2 requires the implementor to provide, kb/Work PB5198, PB5143) and the other forms have no program-visible effect, once its five syntax rules are screened (COBOL6529-COBOL6531, kb/Work PB4945); deleted by ISO 2002 (absent from the whole 2023 text, 8.9 included).
citation: obsolete '85 checkpoint hint deleted by ISO 2002 (absent from the whole 2023 text; §2023:8.9 absence); at 85 the integer-1 RECORDS form records rerun information and the other forms have no effect (§1985:VII.2.12.4 GR2); VCR Table 7 row 7.15; obsolete element (§1985:p.XVII-83 (obsolete list item 5))
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.15; the W3 notInGrammar 85-acceptance batch (DEVLOG 599)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRR1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "vmrr" ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
I-O-CONTROL.
    RERUN ON SYSRR EVERY 10 RECORDS OF F.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT F.
    MOVE "CHECKPOINT" TO R.
    WRITE R.
    CLOSE F.
    STOP RUN.
